features.title: bash tool
features.summary: The forked bash tool keeps upstream execution, sandboxing, approvals and background-job hand-off, and renders a result the model can act on: an exit code on every completed run, a timeout that names its wait and suggests a larger timeoutMs, and a truncated tail that counts whole lines.
failureModes: A profile whose preset-standard row still names @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash keeps the native tool.

verification.testName: ends every completed run with its exit code, zero included
says how long a timed-out command waited and suggests a larger timeout
drops the partial first line of a truncated tail so the line count is exact
